reasoning: Read to the end, the turn carries three acts. (1) «может имеет смысл обогатить аудит скилл» names a possibility the person is not asking to have built now — an idea, and the hedged 'maybe it makes sense' is exactly the phrasing the skill warns not to decide by, so the situation decides: a discussion about how the audit skill behaves, with nothing of that being built at this moment. Per 'An idea is not an instruction', the difference is whether the person is asking for the thing now; they are not. (2) «кинь лайвспеку идею» is an ask for something to be done, so it is its own act and stays named ('No act absorbs another'), but the skill settles what it costs: 'Passing an idea on is not work. Where the ask is to hand the idea itself to someone — tell another project, drop it in their inbox — that is passing a message, done in the turn like an answer: no row, no work item.' Nothing is being made to exist, so this is not the 'ask that makes something exist' that would be an instruction as usual. (3) «может это хорошо для всех холодных читателей если это НЕ спека. в спеке такое не надо, а если тексты, или сообщения то иногда надо такое» is a judgment about the product — where this behaviour helps and where it is unwanted — and 'a judgment about the product ... says something new even when it doubles as the reason for the neighbouring act: it is worth keeping after the act closes'. Where it is unclear whether that clause is its own act or the idea's grounds, 'it is its own act' — naming one too many costs a sentence, one too few loses what somebody said. So it is recorded as an observation, evidence, and its repair does not follow beyond doubt: a competent colleague would still have to ask what change to the audit skill is wanted, which is the 'onboarding copy feels stiff' case, not the '500s' case. No correction (nothing is in flight whose goal changes), no decision (no standing rule — the person is proposing, not settling), no halt. creates_work is false because 'An idea is discussed and creates no durable work until the person asks for it', and saying where an idea belongs commissions nothing; only a direct ask to record it would open a row. shelves_idea is true: the idea half took the idea road — passed on and discussed, with the skill keeping no second list to file it in. work_items is zero, and operation is ['none'], the line for an idea discussed and let go plus an observation kept as evidence — no ticket is admitted, corrected, halted, blocked or unblocked. Because no work was accepted, 'A turn that accepted no work names no dimension and calls no specialist' leaves dimensions and specialists empty.
